grammar_title: 现在完成被动语态(have/has been done)
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第三册 Unit 3 Using language:present perfect passive(have/has been done)。句子地道、科学/发明主题,答案唯一(干扰项为错语态或错时态);零术语、全应用型填空。

points.point: 现在完成被动语态基本形式(have/has been + 过去分词)
points.overview: 主语是动作的承受者、且有现在完成时间标志(recently / so far / over the past years / by + 施动者)时,用 have/has been + 过去分词。

points.point: 现在完成被动 vs 现在完成主动(主语承受 or 发出动作)
points.overview: 看主语是动作的承受者还是发出者:承受者(常带 by 施动者、空后无宾语)用 have/has been done;发出者(空后跟宾语)用 have/has done。

points.point: 现在完成被动 vs 一般现在/一般过去被动(时间标志定时态)
points.overview: 四个选项都是被动,但时态不同;already / so far / up to now / by now 等标志要求现在完成被动 have/has been done,而非 is/are done 或 was/were done。

questions.stem: A great many new inventions ____ by scientists over the past few years.
questions.explanation: 主语 inventions 是动作承受者,又有 over the past few years → have been + made。

questions.stem: Recently, 3D printers ____ by doctors to create replacement hearts.
questions.explanation: printers 被使用、有 recently → have been used。

questions.stem: Since 2010, several new medicines ____ by researchers for this illness.
questions.explanation: medicines 被研发、since 2010 → have been developed。

questions.stem: So far, an intelligent walking house ____ by a clever young team.
questions.explanation: house 被建造、so far → has been built。

questions.stem: Up to now, only part of the energy problem ____ by engineers.
questions.explanation: problem 被解决、up to now → has been solved。

questions.stem: In recent years, the flexible battery ____ greatly by engineers.
questions.explanation: battery 被改进、有 by engineers 施动者 → has been improved。

questions.stem: Just now, a strange new instrument ____ by the inventor.
questions.explanation: instrument 被设计、by the inventor → has been designed。

questions.stem: Over the past decade, many electric cars ____ by Chinese companies.
questions.explanation: cars 被生产、over the past decade → have been produced。

questions.stem: Lately, a smart watch for blind people ____ by a small start-up.
questions.explanation: watch 被创造、lately + by 短语 → has been created。

questions.stem: This year, a cheaper solar panel ____ by the research centre.
questions.explanation: panel 被推出、by the research centre → has been introduced。

questions.stem: Already, the new heart pump ____ by the hospital team.
questions.explanation: pump 被测试、already + by 短语 → has been tested。

questions.stem: For many years, the compass ____ by sailors all over the world.
questions.explanation: compass 被使用、for many years + by 短语 → has been used。

questions.stem: Since last spring, the broken robot ____ by the students.
questions.explanation: robot 被修理、since last spring → has been repaired。

questions.stem: Recently, two damaged machines ____ by the workers.
questions.explanation: machines 被更换、recently + by 短语 → have been replaced。

questions.stem: So far, the old experiment ____ by several scientists.
questions.explanation: experiment 被检验、so far + by 短语 → has been examined。

questions.stem: Over the years, the inventor's story ____ by many writers.
questions.explanation: story 被记述、over the years + by 短语 → has been recorded。

questions.stem: This month, the team's results ____ by a famous science magazine.
questions.explanation: results 被发表、by 短语 → have been published。

questions.stem: Recently, a minor planet ____ after the great scientist.
questions.explanation: planet 被命名、recently → has been named。

questions.stem: Up to now, thousands of stars ____ by that astronomer.
questions.explanation: stars 被研究、up to now + by 短语 → have been studied。

questions.stem: Since the fire, a new 3D-printed shell ____ to the injured turtle.
questions.explanation: shell 被给予、since the fire → has been given。

questions.stem: So far, many great inventions ____ by ordinary people, not just experts.
questions.explanation: 主语 inventions 是承受者、带 by 短语 → have been made。

questions.stem: So far, ordinary people ____ many great inventions, not just experts.
questions.explanation: 主语 people 是发出者、空后跟宾语 inventions → 主动 have made。

questions.stem: Recently, the old theory ____ by more than one scientist.
questions.explanation: theory 是承受者、带 by 短语 → has been questioned。

questions.stem: Recently, more than one scientist ____ the old theory.
questions.explanation: scientist 是发出者、空后跟宾语 theory → 主动 has questioned。

questions.stem: Up to now, the experiment ____ by students all over the country.
questions.explanation: experiment 是承受者、带 by 短语 → has been repeated。

questions.stem: Up to now, students all over the country ____ the experiment.
questions.explanation: students 是发出者、空后跟宾语 experiment → 主动 have repeated。

questions.stem: For centuries, the compass ____ by sailors crossing the sea.
questions.explanation: compass 是承受者、带 by 短语 → has been used。

questions.stem: For centuries, sailors crossing the sea ____ the compass.
questions.explanation: sailors 是发出者、空后跟宾语 compass → 主动 have used。

questions.stem: Lately, replacement body parts ____ by clever 3D printers.
questions.explanation: parts 是承受者、带 by 短语 → have been produced。

questions.stem: Lately, clever 3D printers ____ replacement body parts.
questions.explanation: printers 是发出者、空后跟宾语 parts → 主动 have produced。

questions.stem: This year, a new energy car ____ by that young engineer.
questions.explanation: car 是承受者、带 by 短语 → has been designed。

questions.stem: This year, that young engineer ____ a new energy car.
questions.explanation: engineer 是发出者、空后跟宾语 car → 主动 has designed。

questions.stem: Already, the patient's heart problem ____ by the doctors.
questions.explanation: problem 是承受者、带 by 短语 → has been treated。

questions.stem: Already, the doctors ____ the patient's heart problem.
questions.explanation: doctors 是发出者、空后跟宾语 problem → 主动 have treated。

questions.stem: Since then, Franklin's story ____ by generations of children.
questions.explanation: story 是承受者、带 by 短语 → has been loved。

questions.stem: Since then, generations of children ____ Franklin's story.
questions.explanation: children 是发出者、空后跟宾语 story → 主动 have loved。

questions.stem: Over time, the truth about the apple ____ by several writers.
questions.explanation: truth 是承受者、带 by 短语 → has been doubted。

questions.stem: Over time, several writers ____ the truth about the apple.
questions.explanation: writers 是发出者、空后跟宾语 truth → 主动 have doubted。

questions.stem: Recently, many human body parts ____ with this new technology.
questions.explanation: parts 是承受者、with 表方式而非施动 → have been made。

questions.stem: Recently, this new technology ____ many human body parts.
questions.explanation: technology 是发出者、空后跟宾语 parts → 主动 has made。

questions.stem: By now, the new vaccine ____ to thousands of patients.
questions.explanation: by now 表到目前为止 → 现在完成被动 has been given。

questions.stem: Over the past ten years, many electric cars ____ in this city.
questions.explanation: over the past ten years → 现在完成被动 have been produced。

questions.stem: So far, the broken telescope ____ twice this year.
questions.explanation: so far → 现在完成被动 has been repaired。

questions.stem: Already, the team's results ____ in a famous journal.
questions.explanation: already → 现在完成被动 have been published。

questions.stem: Up to now, the old theory ____ many times.
questions.explanation: up to now → 现在完成被动 has been tested。

questions.stem: Since last year, three new instruments ____ for the lab.
questions.explanation: since last year → 现在完成被动 have been bought。

questions.stem: Recently, the famous experiment ____ by several teams.
questions.explanation: recently → 现在完成被动 has been copied。

questions.stem: Lately, a great deal of money ____ on medical research.
questions.explanation: lately → 现在完成被动 has been spent。

questions.stem: In the last decade, much progress ____ in solar power.
questions.explanation: in the last decade → 现在完成被动 has been made。

questions.stem: This week, the damaged robot ____ at last.
questions.explanation: this week + at last → 现在完成被动 has been fixed。

questions.stem: Up to now, no time machine ____ anywhere in the world.
questions.explanation: up to now → 现在完成被动 has been invented。

questions.stem: So far, the new heart pump ____ on many patients.
questions.explanation: so far → 现在完成被动 has been used。

questions.stem: By now, the science museum ____ by millions of visitors.
questions.explanation: by now → 现在完成被动 has been visited。

questions.stem: Recently, the rare planet ____ after a Chinese scientist.
questions.explanation: recently → 现在完成被动 has been named。

questions.stem: Over the years, the inventor's name ____ almost everywhere.
questions.explanation: over the years → 现在完成被动 has been heard。

questions.stem: Already, the new calendar ____ across the whole country.
questions.explanation: already → 现在完成被动 has been introduced。

questions.stem: Since the fire, the injured turtle ____ a 3D-printed shell.
questions.explanation: since the fire → 现在完成被动 has been given。

questions.stem: Up to now, thousands of stars ____ through this telescope.
questions.explanation: up to now → 现在完成被动 have been studied。

questions.stem: Lately, several old machines ____ with safer ones.
questions.explanation: lately → 现在完成被动 have been replaced。

questions.stem: By now, the whole report ____ into three languages.
questions.explanation: by now → 现在完成被动 has been translated。
